title: Editor E0 task 12b, Spotlight storage slice: the Space Spotlight stores and reads a node document behind its own switch
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20. lib/spaces/spotlight.ts: readSpaceSpotlight reads a stored native node document as nodes (layout.nodes, narrowed to one column of Spotlight blocks, each node keeping its id, bag and hidden flag); spaceSpotlightNodes returns the saved nodes or the starter as nodes; nextSpotlightPreferences takes native:true to store a node document and keeps the stored layout byte for byte on a publish toggle; legacySpotlightWriteError refuses a type-keyed write over stored nodes. saveSpaceSpotlightLayout passes native only when render_path_spotlight is on. Dormant: nothing reads layout.nodes yet. Honest gap: a native Spotlight has no type-keyed projection, so the switch must not be turned on until the editor and the renders move.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const rd=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];const s=rd('lib/spaces/spotlight.ts');if(!s.includes('spaceSpotlightNodes')||!s.includes('legacySpotlightWriteError'))bad.push('no node storage');const a=rd('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/spotlight/actions.ts');if(!a.includes(\"renderPathEnabled('spotlight')\"))bad.push('write ignores the switch');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1052: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Spotlight loses its node storage or its write stops following render_path_spotlight. Behavior is lib/spaces/spotlight.test.ts.
